scenarios.name: Inspect browser display preferences during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Auto expand Representations Folder on Open is enabled for the captured session
the user opens the browser header menu
the submenu offers Hide UCS, Hide Work Features, Hide Notes, Hide Documents and Hide Warnings
it offers Show Extended Names and Hide Blue Dot Indicator
it offers Auto expand Representations Folder on Open and Design View Expansion
Auto expand Representations Folder on Open is checked
